title: Sun with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <line x1='7.5' y1='65.5' x2='15.5' y2='62'/>
    <line x1='92.5' y1='34.5' x2='84.5' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='92.5' y1='65.5' x2='84.5' y2='62'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='url(#sunGrad)' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->

  <ellipse cx='59' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#5D4037'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='42.5' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
